before: Column commands and divider drags address layout columns that count skipped leading grid columns, and divider moves ignore a stretching table width.
after: Column commands carry the grid column identity of their anchor, and divider drags scale the pointer move into authored grid twips.
reason: Operations, shared nodes, and serialization keep their shapes. Only which grid column a local command targets and how many twips a drag writes change, and peers apply the resulting operations unchanged.
